about.content.text: Guides marked 'Needs review' have not been checked by a professional yet. Emergency numbers, climate, tables and quantities may be incomplete or wrong. Do not rely on this app alone in a life-threatening situation.
about.credits.text: Country data: world-countries (ODbL), country-json and countries-and-timezones (MIT), emergency-numbers (MIT, community data). Sun and Moon maths: public NOAA equations and the mean synodic month.
about.draft: Draft text. A lawyer must review the privacy policy and terms before release.
about.p1: Everything you save (favorites, notes, checklists, profile, family plan) stays on this device.
about.p2: The app has no account, no ads and no analytics, and sends nothing about you.
about.p3: The only network use is what you start yourself: downloading an optional AI model.
about.p4: Backups are encrypted files that you keep. Error reports stay on the device.
about.p5: Nearby messages travel only between devices that meet, can be carried by other people's devices, and private channels are encrypted.
about.perm.camera: Camera: only to use the light as a flashlight. No photos are taken.
about.perm.location: Location: only when you ask for your coordinates or the sun and Moon times. It is never sent anywhere.
about.perm.sensors: Motion sensors: only for the compass.
about.title: About, privacy and legal
